title: Mission 17: The Service Desk
story: Promotion: you now hold the service desk pager. Services are long-running workers with two independent switches - RUNNING now (start/stop) and WAKES ON BOOT (enable/disable) - and confusing the two is the classic rookie page at 6 AM after a reboot. Today's queue: bring the web tier up properly, silence a deprecated daemon forever, and diagnose one liar.

badge.name: The Service Desk: Pager Earned
badge.desc: Mastered systemctl by working a real service queue - start, enable, stop, disable, and status-diagnose.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING17.txt in your department directory. Ticket 1: the hexweb service is down. START it (running now - this does NOT touch the boot switch).

checks.fail: hexweb is not active yet (systemctl start; verify with is-active or status).

tasks.brief: Ticket 2: hexweb must also SURVIVE reboots. Flip its OTHER switch: enable it. Two switches, two commands - now both are on.

checks.fail: hexweb is not enabled yet (start affects NOW; enable affects BOOT).
hexweb stopped running - enabling must not have stopped it; check both switches.

tasks.brief: Ticket 3: the hexqueue worker needs the FULL bring-up - running now AND on boot. Both switches, and prove each with its is- command before you close the ticket.

checks.fail: hexqueue will not wake on boot (the second switch).

tasks.brief: Ticket 4: legacyd is deprecated. Retire it COMPLETELY: not running now, and never waking on boot again. Both switches off.

checks.fail: legacyd would still wake on the next boot (disable is the second half of retirement).

tasks.brief: Ticket 5: users say reports are stale. BEFORE touching anything, check hexreportd's status yourself and write your one-word diagnosis - exactly what is-active reports at ticket-open time - to servicedesk/diagnosis.txt in your department directory. (Diagnose first; the fix is the next ticket.)

checks.fail: diagnosis.txt must record what is-active reported when the ticket OPENED (hexreportd starts the shift down - if you fixed it before diagnosing, that is the lesson: diagnose first).

tasks.brief: Ticket 5 continued: whatever you diagnosed, make hexreportd RIGHT: running now and enabled for boot. Close the ticket.

checks.fail: hexreportd is not enabled for boot yet.

checks.cmd: systemctl is-active hexweb >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-enabled hexweb >/dev/null 2>&1
checks.fail: hexweb regressed while you worked later tickets. A service desk never breaks ticket 1 while closing ticket 5.

tasks.brief: BONUS: ops wants proof hexweb survives a bounce. RESTART it and save the restart command's own output line to servicedesk/bounce.txt.

checks.fail: bounce.txt must contain the restart command's output for hexweb (redirect the command).
hexweb did not survive the bounce.
